title: The First White Mile
description: Pause under cabin roofs, read falling-ice warnings, then cross the open snow.

signs.text: The amber mark warns where ice will fall
Leave the roof after the ice passes
Climb the cabin roofs above the drifting snow
Cross one exposed opening at a time
Brake on stone before the final frozen cuts
